On Sun, Mar 21, 2027 at 9:12 AM Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks team — Sasha wrapped interviews this morning (system design, infra, culture). Quick ask: can you drop your scorecard + 2–3 bullet rationale in this thread by EOD today so we can close loop with TalentEdge tomorrow?

Notes / rationale:
- Candidate explains concepts clearly but could not translate to an actionable plan for reducing tail latency on long-context generation (our primary latency pain). The proposals were high level without measurable mitigation steps.
- Limited exposure to GPU-specific optimizations (quantization/fast-kernel trade-offs). Interview examples were all CPU-or-batch focused.
- Concern about debugging in multi-tenant runtime: didn’t provide concrete instrumentation or tracing strategy.

Attached my notes (marcus_notes_rivera.docx). I recommend we pass — candidate would require a heavy ramp and still might not hit the specific infra skills we need in the near term.

— Marcus
